en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, or someone else who said,

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> bequeathed with three hundred Dirhams for mourning him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> used to view that to be from the Sunnah, because Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Take food to the family of Ja’far<sup>as</sup>, for they are too pre-occupied (with their grief)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz or others who has said the following: “

Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said in his will that eight hundred dirhams should be spent to organize a memorial service for his death. He considered it as part of the tradition; the Messenger of Allah had said, ‘Prepare food for the family of Ja‘far; they are preoccupied (with the death of Ja‘far).’”
